item.title: Top commander: Vessels violating Iran’s protocols in southern waters will suffer damage
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran's Armed Forces Chief of Staff Major General Ali Abdollahi has warned that any vessel violating Iranian security protocols in the southern waters “will put itself at risk and face serious damage.”

item.title: Pezeshkian: Iran, Russia and other nations will seek to realize multilateralism
item.description: Moscow, IRNA – Referring to the fact that the Islamic Republic of Iran and the Russian Federation enjoy good relations, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has stressed that the challenge ahead is US unilateralism, which seeks to advance its agenda through bullying; however, together with Russia and other nations, Iran is striving to realize multilateralism globally.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86304321/Pezeshkian-Iran-Russia-and-other-nations-will-seek-to-realize

Moscow, IRNA – Referring to the fact that the Islamic Republic of Iran and the Russian Federation enjoy good relations, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has stressed that the challenge ahead is US unilateralism, which seeks to advance its agenda through bullying; however, together with Russia and other nations, Iran is striving to realize multilateralism globally.

item.title: Leader: A strong Iran is founded upon scientific and technological might
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, in a message addressed to elites and medalists in scientific and athletic competitions on the global stage, highlighted the unparalleled role of these young, high-achieving individuals—who bring honor to the nation in science and sports—in fostering hope, progress, and vitality within the country.
